info.title: Ayra API
info.description: HTTP API for the Ayra e-commerce backend. Protected operations use a Better Auth session cookie. Browser clients should sign in on the same origin before trying protected operations.

sessionCookie.name: ayra.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Better Auth session cookie. HTTPS deployments can use __Secure-ayra.session_token.

get.summary: Get category by slug or nested path
get.description: The slug parameter represents the wildcard category path. Use a single slug (`/categories/saree`) or slash-separated parent and child slugs (`/categories/saree/jamdani`).

post.description: Create a category from a previously uploaded Cloudinary image. Upload once via POST /api/v1/media/upload?type=category. The response variants array is [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]; use variants[0] / imageUrl as image and variants[1] / mobileImageUrl as mobileImage.

get.description: Public catalog of ACTIVE products with cursor pagination by default; page-based pagination remains available when page is supplied. featured=true returns only featured products. onSale=true returns products with at least one variant where compareAtPrice > price. includeInactive and status are applied only for active staff with catalog access.
Public facet counts for the same filters as GET /products. includeInactive and status are applied only for active staff with catalog access.

get.description: Returns Cloudinary CDN images of one type for the admin gallery. Images remain on Cloudinary; this lists unique public ids already uploaded. Excludes SOFT_DELETED. Newest first. Role-gated by type, same as upload.

publicId.description: Unique Cloudinary public id. Files stay on Cloudinary CDN.

variants.description: On-the-fly Cloudinary delivery URLs. Slider and category: [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]. Product: [1200x1200]. Blog: [1600x900]. Site logo: [800x400 fit]. Open Graph image: [1200x630]. Avatars: [400x400].

mobileImageUrl.description: Mobile delivery URL (variants[1]) for slider and category. Absent for types with a single variant.

post.description: Streams one image from disk after magic-byte validation. Role-gated by type: store logo and Open Graph images require the settings permission; product/category/slider/blog require their matching admin permission; customer_avatar requires CUSTOMER or ADMIN. Product bulk uploads must use /media/uploads. Delivery URLs are generated on the fly (f_auto, q_auto). Cloudinary failures return 502 or 504 with { success: false, message }.

type.description: Image type. For multiple product images use POST /api/v1/media/uploads.

image.description: Image file (jpg, jpeg, png, webp). Max 5MB.

publicId.description: Unique Cloudinary public id. Files stay on Cloudinary CDN.

variants.description: On-the-fly Cloudinary delivery URLs. Slider and category: [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]. Product: [1200x1200]. Blog: [1600x900]. Site logo: [800x400 fit]. Open Graph image: [1200x630]. Avatars: [400x400].

mobileImageUrl.description: Mobile delivery URL (variants[1]) for slider and category. Absent for types with a single variant.

post.description: Uploads 1–5 product images after magic-byte validation. ADMIN only. Other image types are rejected.

images.description: Product images (jpg, jpeg, png, webp). Max 5 files, 5MB each.

publicId.description: Unique Cloudinary public id. Files stay on Cloudinary CDN.

variants.description: On-the-fly Cloudinary delivery URLs. Slider and category: [desktop 1920x820, mobile 960x1200]. Product: [1200x1200]. Blog: [1600x900]. Site logo: [800x400 fit]. Open Graph image: [1200x630]. Avatars: [400x400].

mobileImageUrl.description: Mobile delivery URL (variants[1]) for slider and category. Absent for types with a single variant.
